question: What was the average claim cost for auto claims in North Carolina in Q3 2026?

sql:
WITH source AS (
    SELECT c.*, p.channel, p.metro,
           coalesce(pay.paid, 0) AS paid_to_date,
           coalesce(pay.paid, 0) + c.reserve_amount AS incurred,
           c.close_date - c.report_date AS days_to_close
    FROM claims c
    JOIN policies p USING (policy_id)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT claim_id, sum(amount) AS paid FROM claim_payments GROUP BY claim_id
    ) pay USING (claim_id)
)
SELECT sum(incurred) / count(*) AS value
FROM source
WHERE loss_date >= DATE '2026-07-01'
  AND loss_date <= DATE '2026-09-30'
  AND state IN ('NC')
  AND product IN ('auto')

    FROM claims c
    JOIN policies p USING (policy_id)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT claim_id, sum(amount) AS paid FROM claim_payments GROUP BY claim_id
    ) pay USING (claim_id)
)
SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', loss_date) AS DATE) AS period, count(*) AS value
FROM source
WHERE loss_date >= DATE '2026-07-01'
  AND loss_date <= DATE '2026-09-30'
  AND state IN ('NC')
  AND product IN ('auto')
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY ALL

report.interpretation: Average claim cost, defined as incurred (paid plus open reserve) divided by claim count. It covers auto claims in North Carolina with a loss date from 2026-07-01 to 2026-09-30 (Q3 2026), using the agreed company metric.
report.answer: Auto claims in North Carolina in Q3 2026 averaged about $5,887 per claim, across 54 claims (16 in July, 20 in August, 18 in September). The latest weeks are incomplete because claims are reported late. Late September claims will probably still be added, and the average may change as reserves develop.

data_quality_issues.issue: Recent claims are incomplete because of late reporting, so late-September losses are under-counted and Q3 reserves are still developing.
data_quality_issues.impact: The Q3 average may change as more claims are reported.

data_quality_issues.issue: claim_payments has 159 exact duplicate rows from the reload-2026-03-14 batch, covering payments dated 2026-03-02 to 2026-03-13.
data_quality_issues.impact: These payments pre-date Q3, so they don't affect Q3 losses. They do overstate paid amounts on older claims.

proposed_actions.title: Remove duplicate payment rows from reload-2026-03-14
proposed_actions.reason: 159 duplicate payment rows inflate paid and incurred amounts for claims with March 2026 payments.
